deep-copy printarea/variant/mockup/display settings voi ID moi; SKU giu nguyen; label/internal_tags giu nguyen

observed_behavior.statement: Muc xac nhan truoc thao tac pha huy/nhan ban khong nhat quan: xoa printarea - chay ngay; archive - khong hoi; duplicate - khong hoi; delete product base - CO dialog + deletion-check truoc.
Response archive tra full record, lo 2 field chua tung thay o response khac (variants_position, print_provider_id).
Response clone (POST /clone) la chinh record NGUON (3203), khong phai ban sao (3206) - portal phai refetch list de biet id ban sao, khong dieu huong sang ban sao.
Clone copy title kem hau to ' copy'; label/internal_tags GIU NGUYEN; deep-copy 1 printarea + 2 variant (SKU giu nguyen) + 1 mockup + toan bo Display settings voi ID moi.
deletion-check tra 2 branch: allowed {reason:null,token:null} hoac blocked {reason:'IN_CAMPAIGNS',token:null}; field token luon null o ca 2 sample, muc dich chua ro.
DELETE product base tra 204 khong body; sample duy nhat la product DA archive tu truoc - chua biet DELETE tren product dang active (chua archive) co duoc chap nhan khong.

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner); chua biet role khac co bi gioi han archive/duplicate/delete hay khong.

data.item: products.status (archive toggle); ban sao deep-copy printareas/variants/mockups/display settings voi ID moi

dependencies.relation: deletion-check tra 'IN_CAMPAIGNS' khi product base dang duoc campaign dung

risks.risk: Response clone (/clone) tra ve record NGUON thay vi ban sao - bat ky consumer nao goi API clone truc tiep (ngoai portal) se khong lay duoc id vua tao tu response, de dan toi loi logic o integration khac.
Muc xac nhan truoc hanh dong pha huy/nhan ban khong nhat quan (archive/duplicate khong hoi, chi delete moi hoi) - rui ro thao tac nham khong the hoan tac cho archive/duplicate.

Field 'token' trong deletion-check luon null o ca 2 sample quan sat duoc, muc dich/dieu kien co gia tri chua ro - co the la co che bao ve (idempotency/anti-tamper) chua duoc kich hoat hoac dead code; can lam ro truoc khi coi delete flow la an toan.

Chua xac nhan DELETE co thuc su bi chan phia server khi deletion-check.policy='blocked' (IN_CAMPAIGNS) hay chi la goi y cho UI - chua test vi nam trong forbidden_actions (khong bam Delete tren asset co campaign dung).
Response archive tra full record lo them field chua thay o response khac (variants_position, print_provider_id) - be mat du lieu tra ve khong nhat quan giua cac endpoint.
